notes.title: Spy Bros v1.0.4 - TOAPLAN ♥ PATCH! Celebrating SpyBros. anniversary!
notes.notes:
We're celebrating the first anniversary of SpyBros. release! 🥳

Here comes the "TOAPLAN ♥ PATCH" changelog:
· Added new achievement: HACKER!
· Many small bugfixes and improved timings.
· Reduced bonus time to 30s.
· Now the VS mode ends after playing one world, not the whole game.
· Some new cheats and... secrets... 👀
